topic: King Charles and the Spencer book
caption: "king charles" — 5,000+ searches today. Swipe for 10 things most people don't know about the book that made the Palace answer.

Why: Charles Spencer, Princess Diana's brother, publishes "Swan Song: Diana, My Sister" on September 22. In an excerpt the Daily Mail printed early, he says the then-Prince Charles told him in 1997: "Rest assured, we'll forget her soon enough." On September 16 a Palace spokesperson replied that grief "can cloud reason, affect judgment and color memory".

What most people don't know: the same statement says the Palace does not comment on books "as a matter of principle". The 1997 row was over whether William and Harry, then 15 and 12, should walk behind their mother's coffin.
Very simply put: one sentence from 1997 got the King to answer in 2026.
